Greek fighter jet crashes during airshow near Athens

A Greek air force F-4 fighter jet crashed during an aerial show north of Athens on Tuesday, in front of thousands of spectators. The crash ignited a large fire at the event. The aircraft reportedly exploded upon impact. No casualties were reported in the coverage.
